outcome: nutritional status (BMI/A, W/A, H/A, HC/A z-scores)
cohort: Seventy-one children born between March 2016 and June 2018 who were exposed to Zika virus during pregnancy and followed up in a tertiary unit in the Amazon.
finding: The study found low growth velocity in children with and without microcephaly, emphasizing the need for continuous evaluation of all children born to mothers exposed to ZIKV during pregnancy.
